$comment: Georgia metro-area zoning posture for modular edge data-center pods. Verify per-tract before every site option. Status values: NO (do not deploy), YES_WITH_LETTER (deploy after written zoning-verification letter), BEST (industrial-friendly + cooperative EDC), UNKNOWN (screen and update).

jurisdictions.name: City of Atlanta
jurisdictions.reason: Ordinance 24-O-1222 (Sept 3, 2024) — use-based definition, no size floor. 2,640 ft buffer from high-capacity transit stops. Beltline Overlay ban. Container form factor captured by definition.

jurisdictions.name: Coweta County (Newnan corridor)
jurisdictions.reason: Industrial overlay welcoming; cooperative EDC. Georgia Power + Coweta-Fayette EMC. Multiple OZ-eligible tracts. Outer tracts likely rural-qualifying; Newnan corridor itself likely inside Atlanta urbanized-area extension.

jurisdictions.name: Clayton County (Jonesboro corridor)
jurisdictions.reason: Major Georgia Power sub-transmission feeds. Industrial-friendly zoning. Best latency to central Atlanta demand. NOT rural — entirely within Atlanta urbanized area, so QROF wrapper unavailable here.

jurisdictions.name: Jackson County (Commerce / Jefferson)
jurisdictions.reason: I-85 corridor, Atlanta / Charlotte fiber access. Jackson EMC + Georgia Power. Outer tracts likely rural-qualifying for QROF.

jurisdictions.name: Newton County (east of Covington)
jurisdictions.reason: East metro. Screen ordinance individually; most scale-triggered. Outer tracts likely rural-qualifying.

jurisdictions.name: Barrow County
jurisdictions.reason: Northeast metro I-85 corridor. Outer tracts likely rural-qualifying.

jurisdictions.name: Douglas County
jurisdictions.reason: West metro. Some hyperscale interest (Meta area). Most inside urbanized area — QROF unlikely for most tracts.

jurisdictions.name: Carroll County
jurisdictions.reason: West metro. Outer tracts west of Carrollton likely rural-qualifying.

jurisdictions.name: White County (Helen corridor)
jurisdictions.reason: Rural. Cooperative county commissioners. Multiple OZ-eligible tracts. Definitively rural for QROF.

jurisdictions.name: Rabun County
jurisdictions.reason: Definitively rural. Blue Ridge EMC + hydro proximity.

jurisdictions.name: Habersham / Hart / Franklin / Elbert
jurisdictions.reason: Definitively rural. Wheeling / interconnect distance to Atlanta market rises the further out.

jurisdictions.name: Bulloch / Emanuel / Jefferson (South GA)
jurisdictions.reason: Rural. Georgia Power + strong solar potential. Savannah PoP proximity. Lowest land basis.

urbanizedAreaCaveat: IRC §1400Z-2 rural test requires the tract to be (i) outside any city / town with population > 50,000 AND (ii) outside any Census-defined urbanized area contiguous and adjacent to such a city / town. Verify each candidate tract against the certified 2027 QOZ map and the Census urbanized-area boundary for Atlanta / Marietta before signing any option. Per-tract test — not per-county.
